description: Report something on CarlNotes to its admins: a topic, profile, team, team chat message, tasting note, note comment, finding, podcast episode, hot take, topic image, or Open Mic post's image, whose kind is topicPostImage. The report goes to the same queue as a report from the site, under the same daily limit, and can block the author too. Use it when the user asks Carl or CarlNotes to report this, flag this, or report this person.

reason.description: What is wrong, in the user's words.

should_block_author.description: Whether to block the author too.

subject_id.description: The id of what is reported.

subject_kind.description: What is reported. An Open Mic post's image is a topicPostImage.

name: report_content
title: Report something
